facts.text: Established in 1927 by Roger Babson as the first college chartered under Florida's then new charitable and educational laws, Webber was founded as America's second business school for women.

sources.title: Webber Prepares to Welcome Back Students for 99th Year
sources.quote: Established in 1927 by Roger Babson as the first college chartered under Florida's then new charitable and educational laws, Webber International University is a private, not-for-profit, independent institution offering degrees at the associate's, bachelor's, and master's levels.
